modes.canonical_mitigation: Before and after a rollback, capture the repository diff and restrict restoration or deletion to an explicit allowlist of files changed by the requested implementation; abort if any unrelated path appears.
member_canonical_names: Over-broad rollback deleting an unrelated file

modes.canonical_name: Failure to implement a requested user-selectable onboarding option
modes.definition: The agent implemented passive detection of an existing setting instead of adding the explicit onboarding choice and configuration action requested by the user.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Use an acceptance-criteria checklist that requires an explicit code path and test for each requested interaction: present the onboarding choice, create the local repository when selected, configure and persist the remote, and verify indexing fetches from it.
member_canonical_names: Failure to implement a requested user-selectable onboarding option

modes.canonical_name: Computing an expected artifact location that disagrees with the system under test
modes.definition: The agent implemented an end-to-end assertion using an inferred session directory that did not match the transcript location actually produced by the command.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Build the expected transcript path using the same public path-resolution inputs used by the resume command, compare it with the path reported by the command, and assert that the exact reported file exists rather than merely checking a separately inferred directory.
member_canonical_names: Computing an expected artifact location that disagrees with the system under test

modes.canonical_name: Failure to add requested coverage for interactive cancellation behavior
modes.definition: The agent left the confirmation-and-cancellation path untested after the user explicitly identified that coverage gap.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add an integration test that enables accessible prompt mode, supplies cancellation input through stdin, invokes reset without the force flag, and asserts that both the shadow branch and matching session files remain intact.
member_canonical_names: Failure to add requested coverage for interactive cancellation behavior

modes.canonical_name: Failure to scope cached data by an explicit entity identifier
modes.definition: Cached responses and notes were matched using semantic similarity, geographic overlap, or text extraction instead of a durable exact association with the currently selected entity, repeatedly allowing data from other entities to appear.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Store the entity ID as a dedicated indexed field on every cache and note record, require it in cache writes and requests, and enforce exact entity-ID equality in all retrieval and feedback queries with cross-entity isolation tests, including alphabetic-only IDs.
member_canonical_names: Failure to scope cached data by an explicit entity identifier

modes.canonical_name: Mapping persisted data with an incorrect schema
modes.definition: The agent implemented data loading against field names and locations that did not match the actual serialized data, causing required values to remain empty or zero.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before changing loader mappings, inspect representative persisted records and add fixture-based decoding tests that assert every required displayed field is populated from the real schema.
member_canonical_names: Mapping persisted data with an incorrect schema

modes.canonical_name: Implementing ownership assignment without updating ownership-based access filtering
modes.definition: The agent made an ownership field assignable but did not initially make the assigned assets visible through the new owner's read-access and filtering paths.
modes.canonical_mitigation: For ownership features, trace the value from assignment through every authorization and retrieval path, then add an integration test that assigns an item to a user, authenticates as that user, and verifies the item appears in list and detail responses.
member_canonical_names: Implementing ownership assignment without updating ownership-based access filtering

modes.canonical_name: Unjustified policy refusal of benign informational requests

modes.canonical_mitigation: Before issuing a policy refusal, require the request to match a specific prohibited-content category; explicitly allow neutral factual discussion of political and historical topics and route unmatched requests to a normal answer.
member_canonical_names: Unjustified policy refusal of benign informational requests

modes.canonical_name: Premature plan publication before completing dependency and sequencing review
modes.definition: The agent writes and presents a plan as ready while known inconsistencies, unverified dependency targets, or materially flawed phase ordering remain unresolved.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require a pre-publication upgrade-plan gate that classifies every bump by semver level, captures a baseline audit, queries the latest compatible release for every retained pin, orders urgent remediation before cleanup, and blocks writing the plan until all detected inconsistencies are corrected.
member_canonical_names: Premature plan publication before completing dependency and sequencing review

modes.canonical_name: Failure to incorporate review findings into the artifact under review
modes.definition: The agent identified actionable security defects in an implementation plan but left the executable plan unchanged and recorded the findings only in a separate review document.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When a review finds actionable issues, update the affected PLAN.md tasks, must-haves, and verification steps, rerun the plan checker, and confirm via git diff that each finding is represented before declaring the plan ready.
member_canonical_names: Failure to incorporate review findings into the artifact under review

modes.canonical_name: Implementing downstream workarounds instead of correcting the upstream identifier contract
modes.definition: The agent modified downstream database relation handling to accommodate an invalid identifier before establishing and enforcing which identifier the caller was required to provide.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before changing downstream persistence logic for an identifier mismatch, trace the identifier from its input boundary to the database schema, document whether it is an external ID or primary key, and normalize or reject it at the boundary so downstream code receives only the contracted identifier type.
member_canonical_names: Implementing downstream workarounds instead of correcting the upstream identifier contract

modes.canonical_name: Fragmented restoration state causing race and stale-intent regressions
modes.definition: The agent coordinated one-time restoration and navigation behavior through competing effects and persistent flags, causing later layout updates and saves to apply obsolete state or overwrite the intended position.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Implement restoration as a single explicit state machine with phases such as waiting, applying, and restored; atomically consume one-shot navigation intents, suppress progress saves until restoration completes, and add regression tests for hard refresh, previous-chapter navigation, and post-restore page-count changes.
member_canonical_names: Fragmented restoration state causing race and stale-intent regressions

modes.canonical_name: Dropping required content variants during state persistence and reconstruction
modes.definition: The agent implemented persistence and loading for composite conversation content in a way that preserved one segment type while causing other required segment types to disappear.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add a round-trip regression test that persists and reloads representative conversations containing thinking, answer, tool, and no-tool variants, asserting the exact ordered segments before accepting any implementation change.
member_canonical_names: Dropping required content variants during state persistence and reconstruction

modes.canonical_name: Failure to account for inherited configuration in an environment-specific fix
modes.definition: The agent changed local environment configuration without tracing merged configuration sources, leaving an inherited property active and the targeted runtime error unresolved.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before finalizing an environment-specific configuration fix, inspect the effective merged configuration from all application and dependency resources, then explicitly override the problematic inherited property in the highest-priority environment-specific source.
member_canonical_names: Failure to account for inherited configuration in an environment-specific fix

modes.canonical_name: Display aggregation without canonicalizing equivalent entities
modes.definition: The agent collapsed output to one row per existing group without ensuring that multiple representations of the same underlying project were assigned to the same group.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Resolve a canonical project identity before presentation using normalized remotes plus a documented fallback for unavailable repositories and workspace-manager paths, then add an end-to-end fixture asserting that regular and managed-workspace checkouts of one project produce exactly one group and one output row.
member_canonical_names: Display aggregation without canonicalizing equivalent entities

modes.canonical_name: Over-applying brand accent color to neutral interface surfaces

modes.canonical_mitigation: Enforce semantic color-role constraints with a CSS token audit: neutral surface, text, and border tokens must stay below a defined chroma threshold, while the brand hue is allowlisted only for primary actions, active states, and focus indicators.
member_canonical_names: Over-applying brand accent color to neutral interface surfaces

modes.canonical_name: Under-scoped implementation of a comprehensive design overhaul

modes.canonical_mitigation: Create a section-by-section inventory of every component, interaction state, and visual pattern in the target interface, track each through browser inspection and interaction testing, and prohibit completion claims until the full inventory has been reviewed and addressed.
member_canonical_names: Under-scoped implementation of a comprehensive design overhaul

modes.canonical_name: Running a capability-limited adapter against an unfiltered shared test suite

modes.canonical_mitigation: Require each CI matrix entry to declare an explicit capability-based test filter, use that filter in every workflow invocation, and reject specialized entries whose generated command would run the unfiltered suite.
member_canonical_names: Running a capability-limited adapter against an unfiltered shared test suite

modes.canonical_name: Incomplete inspection of requested review feedback

modes.canonical_mitigation: When asked to inspect pull-request feedback, parse any supplied URL or review ID and query all relevant surfaces—review bodies, inline review comments, review threads, and general comments—before concluding that no action is required.
member_canonical_names: Incomplete inspection of requested review feedback

modes.canonical_name: Granting implicit access to explicitly authorized resources

modes.canonical_name: Failure to enforce required authorization conditions for a privileged action

modes.canonical_mitigation: Implement a centralized eligibility predicate covering privileged roles, asset ownership, shared workgroups, and mapped or shared cloud accounts; use it to gate the UI action and enforce the same policy at the request endpoint, with tests for every allowed and denied case.

modes.canonical_name: Substituting a specification file for requested executable automation

modes.canonical_name: Declaring a production runtime issue fixed without runtime validation

modes.canonical_name: Unsupported zero-defect completion claim after limited validation

modes.canonical_name: Persistently narrowing scope despite an explicit payload-inspection requirement

modes.canonical_name: Premature completeness claim before exhaustive per-change comparison

modes.canonical_mitigation: Enumerate every changed hunk from the supplied diff in a checklist and compare each one against both the base branch and current working branch, recording file-and-symbol evidence before making any completeness claim.
member_canonical_names: Premature completeness claim before exhaustive per-change comparison

modes.canonical_name: Categorical technical diagnosis without confirming current system capabilities

modes.canonical_mitigation: Before asserting a product limitation or prescribing architectural replacement, inspect the installed version's schema or documentation and run a minimal capability test; explicitly mark any remaining conclusion as provisional.

modes.canonical_name: Over-broad modification of persistence logic for a presentation-only task

member_canonical_names: Over-broad modification of persistence logic for a presentation-only task

modes.canonical_name: Failure to update downstream consumers after changing shared fee behavior

modes.canonical_mitigation: Before declaring a cross-cutting behavior change complete, run a repository-wide search for calculations and assertions involving the changed fee, update every affected consumer across languages, and execute or inspect the corresponding CI test suites.

modes.canonical_name: Failure to propagate a new option through existing creation workflows

modes.canonical_mitigation: When adding an enum-like option, search the repository for all validators, generators, CLI argument handlers, and hard-coded option lists referencing that field, update each affected path, and execute the corresponding creation command with the new option.

modes.canonical_name: Making a default-path dependency optional without updating the default installation path

modes.canonical_name: Failure to honor an explicit cancellation instruction

member_canonical_names: Failure to honor an explicit cancellation instruction

modes.canonical_name: Omitting an explicitly required target from a multi-file refactor

modes.canonical_name: Incorrectly suppressing fallback data when primary state exists

modes.canonical_mitigation: Merge output from all event sources by run identifier instead of selecting one source based on metadata presence, and add an integration test where the primary execution path is created, fails, and the fallback path emits visible output.
member_canonical_names: Incorrectly suppressing fallback data when primary state exists

modes.canonical_name: Over-restrictive revision filtering that drops pending carry-forward work

member_canonical_names: Over-restrictive revision filtering that drops pending carry-forward work

modes.canonical_name: Selecting an artifact from the wrong provider despite an explicit provider context

modes.canonical_mitigation: Add provider-scoped transcript resolution that searches only the selected agent's storage paths, plus an integration test with both providers' transcripts present that asserts an attach request selects the transcript from the requested provider.
member_canonical_names: Selecting an artifact from the wrong provider despite an explicit provider context

modes.canonical_name: Passing an incompatible session token to an identity-token verification endpoint

modes.canonical_mitigation: Before integrating an authentication token, add a contract test that obtains the exact runtime token and verifies it through the target backend verifier, asserting its issuer, audience, algorithm, and required claims.
member_canonical_names: Passing an incompatible session token to an identity-token verification endpoint

modes.canonical_name: Insufficient automated test coverage for newly added code

modes.canonical_name: Removal of explicitly required readiness checks during simplification

modes.canonical_name: Failure to suppress command usage output for handled runtime errors

member_canonical_names: Failure to suppress command usage output for handled runtime errors

modes.canonical_name: Incorrectly documenting strategy-specific implementation behavior

modes.canonical_name: Declaring a bug fix successful without reproducing the reported end-to-end scenario

member_canonical_names: Declaring a bug fix successful without reproducing the reported end-to-end scenario

modes.canonical_name: Adding logging metadata support without propagating it to runtime call sites

modes.canonical_name: Reporting zero test coverage despite existing behavioral tests

modes.canonical_name: Over-broad authorization that bypasses per-resource permissions

modes.canonical_name: Updating shared configuration without reconciling dependent components

modes.canonical_name: Out-of-scope implementation instead of answering the requested feasibility question

modes.canonical_name: Shipping changes that fail repository formatting checks

modes.canonical_name: Proceeding past a mandatory test gate despite test failures

modes.canonical_name: Claiming production behavior is verified using harnesses that only test reimplemented models

modes.canonical_name: Failure to include explicitly required content in error logging

modes.canonical_name: Premature repository changes before diagnosing a CI failure

modes.canonical_name: Repeatedly asserting dependency capabilities from a stale local checkout

modes.canonical_mitigation: Before asserting that a dependency feature is absent, fetch the remote and inspect the exact pinned tag or commit, verifying that the local checkout's HEAD matches that ref.

modes.canonical_name: Failure to apply all requested revisions before reporting completion

member_canonical_names: Failure to apply all requested revisions before reporting completion

modes.canonical_name: Pre-classifying specialist inputs in the routing layer

modes.canonical_mitigation: Enforce a dispatcher-specialist interface that accepts only an intent and verbatim relevant user excerpts, rejects dispatcher-generated entity classifications or imperative rewrites, and includes a contract test asserting that dispatched content preserves the user's hierarchy.
member_canonical_names: Pre-classifying specialist inputs in the routing layer

modes.canonical_name: Recommending configuration incompatible with the detected framework mode

modes.canonical_name: Leaving retained PR creation without usable workflow authorization

member_canonical_names: Leaving retained PR creation without usable workflow authorization

modes.canonical_name: Dismissal of an explicit runtime diagnostic without addressing the identified incompatibility

modes.canonical_name: Failure to preserve canonical artifact schema in an alternate workflow

modes.canonical_name: Debiting reimbursement from the wrong funding account

modes.canonical_name: Masking defective product behavior with a test-only workaround
modes.definition: The agent made the failing test invoke a special operation required by the defective implementation instead of initially fixing and directly testing the expected user-facing behavior.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When an end-to-end test exposes a user-visible defect, preserve a regression case that exercises the expected workflow without special trigger operations, fix the product path until that case passes, and only add test-specific triggers when the test explicitly concerns those triggers.
member_canonical_names: Masking defective product behavior with a test-only workaround

modes.canonical_name: Providing instructions instead of performing the requested action
modes.definition: The agent responds to an actionable installation request with self-service directions without attempting the installation or establishing that execution is unavailable.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Classify requests phrased as “can you install” as action requests, attempt the installation with the available execution tools, and only provide manual instructions after encountering and reporting a concrete execution or permission barrier.
member_canonical_names: Providing instructions instead of performing the requested action

modes.canonical_name: Destructive mutation of shared repository state during diagnostic testing
modes.definition: The agent tested a hypothesis by committing and pushing from a live worktree, unintentionally publishing staged destructive changes to a shared branch.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require a clean-index preflight using `git status --porcelain` and `git diff --cached --quiet`, perform test commits only on a disposable branch or isolated worktree, and block non-dry-run pushes unless the exact ref update has been reviewed and explicitly approved.
member_canonical_names: Destructive mutation of shared repository state during diagnostic testing

modes.canonical_name: Skipping required review checkpoints during batched plan execution
modes.definition: The agent executed the entire implementation plan without pausing after the prescribed task batch for user review and authorization to continue.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Use an execution controller that limits each batch to the plan's configured task count and blocks subsequent tasks until the agent has reported verification results and received an explicit continuation response from the user.
member_canonical_names: Skipping required review checkpoints during batched plan execution

modes.canonical_name: Disabling a failing test instead of resolving its failure
modes.definition: The agent made CI pass by conditionally skipping a required test when its dependency was unavailable, rather than preserving the test and addressing or reporting the underlying infrastructure failure.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add a review guard that rejects CI-fix changes introducing test skips, conditional test bypasses, or reduced assertions unless the user explicitly approves them; when an external dependency is unavailable, preserve the test and report the blocking infrastructure issue.
member_canonical_names: Disabling a failing test instead of resolving its failure

modes.canonical_name: Rejecting a previously supported execution path instead of extending it for the new requirement
modes.definition: The agent disabled mint creation in CPI-context write mode rather than propagating the required fee accounts and charging the new fee through that existing execution path.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before adding a rejection for a path missing newly required data, enumerate its existing successful use cases and update every account parser and SDK builder for that path, guarded by regression tests covering single-call and multi-call workflows.
member_canonical_names: Rejecting a previously supported execution path instead of extending it for the new requirement

modes.canonical_name: Failure to make requested README media visibly render
modes.definition: The agent added README references to requested media in a form that did not visibly render for the user.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Preview the modified README with GitHub-compatible rendering and confirm that every referenced image path resolves and displays before committing.
member_canonical_names: Failure to make requested README media visibly render

modes.canonical_name: Failure to act on an explicit error report
modes.definition: The agent responds generically instead of acknowledging and investigating a user-reported failure, forcing the user to restate the problem.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Route messages containing explicit error or failure text into a troubleshooting flow that acknowledges the error and either begins repository/runtime inspection or asks for specific missing context before offering a generic greeting.
member_canonical_names: Failure to act on an explicit error report

modes.canonical_name: Claiming a behavioral fix complete without performing the requested runtime verification
modes.definition: The agent declared an interactive behavior corrected after only build validation, despite an explicit runtime verification requirement that subsequently exposed a remaining defect.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Gate completion claims on executing every requested verification step; when interactive verification cannot be performed, explicitly mark it as unverified and avoid claiming the behavior is fixed.
member_canonical_names: Claiming a behavioral fix complete without performing the requested runtime verification

modes.canonical_name: Incomplete propagation of an API route-prefix change to clients
modes.definition: The agent moved server endpoints under a new route prefix without updating the built client to send requests to that prefix, causing API calls to hit the SPA fallback and return HTML.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Centralize the API prefix in one shared configuration and add an end-to-end test that builds and launches the application using the user's exact command, then verifies both the browser's requested URLs and JSON content types for representative endpoints.
member_canonical_names: Incomplete propagation of an API route-prefix change to clients

modes.canonical_name: Overwriting cumulative file content instead of appending new entries
modes.definition: The agent implemented repeated prompt persistence as a file replacement operation, causing each new prompt to erase previously stored prompts.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Route prompt persistence through a single append helper that preserves existing content and inserts the defined delimiter, then add a multi-turn test asserting that prompt.txt contains every prompt in order after two or more turn-start events.
member_canonical_names: Overwriting cumulative file content instead of appending new entries

modes.canonical_name: Describing a change set without inspecting the requested base diff
modes.definition: The agent summarizes or documents branch changes from a specified base without first examining that exact base-to-head diff, resulting in an incomplete or inaccurate description.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before creating or revising any branch-level summary, require running and reviewing both `git diff --stat <base>...HEAD` and `git diff <base>...HEAD`, then derive every summary bullet from that output.
member_canonical_names: Describing a change set without inspecting the requested base diff

modes.canonical_name: Renderer configuration preserves source markup contrary to requested formatted output
modes.definition: The agent switched content to a renderer whose active style retained visible source-syntax markers, leaving the output inconsistent with the user's expectation of fully formatted content.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add a representative renderer test that strips ANSI styling and asserts heading prefixes such as `#`, `##`, and `###` are absent, then configure all heading levels to use empty prefixes before integrating the renderer.
member_canonical_names: Renderer configuration preserves source markup contrary to requested formatted output

modes.canonical_name: Failure to complete remote publication required for dashboard visibility
modes.definition: The agent stopped after configuring local checkpoint creation and deferred the remote push needed to make checkpoints appear on the requested dashboard.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Use an end-to-end completion gate that verifies the checkpoint branch exists on the configured remote and is visible through the service; if pushing requires approval, explicitly request it and perform the push before declaring the task complete.
member_canonical_names: Failure to complete remote publication required for dashboard visibility

modes.canonical_name: Misapplying a default-value request as a keyed mapping override
modes.definition: The agent changed the value associated with a specific platform instead of changing which platform is selected as the fallback default.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before editing configuration from a terse follow-up, explicitly distinguish the fallback selector from the selected option's mapped value, and request clarification when the instruction does not identify which one should change.
member_canonical_names: Misapplying a default-value request as a keyed mapping override

modes.canonical_name: Advancing after interactive prompts captured no user answer
modes.definition: The agent continued the discussion workflow despite the question mechanism completing without recording the user's selections, requiring the user to report that questions were being skipped.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add a post-prompt gate that requires a nonempty, explicit user response before advancing; after one empty or auto-completed result, stop using the question tool and fall back to numbered questions in plain chat.
member_canonical_names: Advancing after interactive prompts captured no user answer

modes.canonical_name: Over-broad behavior change by removing an eligibility guard
modes.definition: The agent removed a guard and applied new behavior to every active case even though only the failed-attempt case required that behavior.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before weakening an existing guard, enumerate its meaningful outcome states and add branch-specific tests; preserve the guard for unaffected states and introduce an explicit predicate for only the newly required state.
member_canonical_names: Over-broad behavior change by removing an eligibility guard

modes.canonical_name: Incorrectly declaring no new feedback after querying truncated comment results
modes.definition: The agent reports that no new review feedback exists after inspecting only a limited, non-paginated subset of comments or thread replies.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before declaring that no new feedback exists, paginate through all review comments and review-thread replies, then compare the newest comment IDs and timestamps across every unresolved thread.
member_canonical_names: Incorrectly declaring no new feedback after querying truncated comment results

modes.canonical_name: Implementing a fix in an entrypoint already identified as non-executing
modes.definition: The agent modified and declared complete logic inside a framework entrypoint without first ensuring that the application would discover and execute that entrypoint.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before changing entrypoint logic, verify its required location against the installed framework version and confirm execution with a temporary runtime marker or network-event smoke test; block completion claims until that check passes.
member_canonical_names: Implementing a fix in an entrypoint already identified as non-executing

modes.canonical_name: Incomplete implementation of required hook acknowledgments
modes.definition: The agent added stdout acknowledgment for only some hook paths while leaving required lifecycle hooks capable of returning without output.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add a table-driven integration test that invokes every supported hook path, including repeated turn-start and turn-end events, and asserts that each successful invocation emits at least one byte to stdout.
member_canonical_names: Incomplete implementation of required hook acknowledgments

modes.canonical_name: Replacing a working database index with an unvalidated replacement
modes.definition: The agent removed a working index and installed a replacement before confirming that the replacement was valid and improved the target query.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Use a staged index migration that creates the replacement concurrently without dropping the existing index, checks pg_index.indisvalid and indisready, benchmarks representative queries with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, and removes the old index only after the replacement passes those checks.
member_canonical_names: Replacing a working database index with an unvalidated replacement

modes.canonical_name: Changing a nested bind-mount destination without ensuring parent-directory permissions
modes.definition: The agent moved a container bind mount beneath a runtime-user-owned path without ensuring the intermediate directory could be created or accessed by that user, causing container startup failure.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When changing a container mount destination, explicitly provision every parent directory with the runtime UID/GID or mount a writable volume/tmpfs for the parent, then start the container as its actual runtime user and require its health check to pass.
member_canonical_names: Changing a nested bind-mount destination without ensuring parent-directory permissions

modes.canonical_name: Prolonged planning after explicit direction to proceed with implementation
modes.definition: The agent continued an extended planning process after the user delegated decisions and expected implementation to begin.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Timebox design work and, when the user explicitly delegates the decision, record a concise chosen approach and begin the first implementation step immediately, with a progress update within a fixed short interval.
member_canonical_names: Prolonged planning after explicit direction to proceed with implementation

modes.canonical_name: Over-broad application of an environment-specific networking workaround
modes.definition: The agent applied a networking workaround intended for one runtime and host environment to other deployment configurations where it broke connectivity.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Gate runtime-specific network resolution behind explicit host, containerization, and runtime detection, preserve the existing default for unaffected configurations, and run a compatibility matrix covering native and containerized deployments with each supported runtime before declaring the fix complete.
member_canonical_names: Over-broad application of an environment-specific networking workaround

modes.canonical_name: Incorrect tree scope for path-relative metadata lookup
modes.definition: The agent performed metadata lookup against a tree whose root did not match the path convention expected by the lookup, causing locally available files to be reported as missing.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Centralize checkpoint-tree selection in a helper that resolves the canonical shared checkpoint path, returns that exact subtree, and requires all subsequent metadata reads to use paths relative to it; add an integration test with a sharded multi-session checkpoint that asserts the selected subtree hash and successful metadata lookup.
member_canonical_names: Incorrect tree scope for path-relative metadata lookup

modes.canonical_name: Running an interactive CLI workflow unattended without its noninteractive mode
modes.definition: The agent launched commands requiring interactive approval as background jobs without the flag that suppresses the prompt, causing repeated command failures.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before launching a CLI workflow in the background, run one representative task in the foreground and require an exit code of zero using documented noninteractive flags such as `--dry-run`; only then start the remaining tasks.
member_canonical_names: Running an interactive CLI workflow unattended without its noninteractive mode

modes.canonical_name: Prematurely dismissing persistent service failures as transient startup behavior
modes.definition: The agent characterized repeated connection failures as a harmless startup race before checking whether the backend and its required dependency were actually healthy.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before labeling connection errors transient, inspect the target service status and logs and directly probe its health endpoint; only conclude a startup race if the service subsequently becomes healthy without intervention.
member_canonical_names: Prematurely dismissing persistent service failures as transient startup behavior

modes.canonical_name: Failure to investigate and answer a user-raised alternative root cause
modes.definition: The agent responds to a direct challenge of its diagnosis by restating the original diagnosis without evaluating or answering the alternative causal hypothesis.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When the user proposes an alternative root cause, explicitly test it against the available code, inputs, and failure evidence, then provide a direct yes-or-no answer with supporting findings before retaining or revising the diagnosis.
member_canonical_names: Failure to investigate and answer a user-raised alternative root cause

modes.canonical_name: Manual modification of automation-managed version fields despite repository guard
modes.definition: The agent manually changed a version field that repository policy explicitly reserves for automated release tooling.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before editing or staging changes, compare all repository-designated managed version files against the base branch and block agent-authored modifications unless the task is an explicitly authorized recovery procedure.
member_canonical_names: Manual modification of automation-managed version fields despite repository guard

modes.canonical_name: Editing a skill without the required test-first cycle
modes.definition: The agent modified an existing skill without first recording a failing baseline scenario and then rerunning that scenario to verify the revised skill.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Enforce a write gate for skill files that requires stored RED-phase baseline results before editing and stored GREEN-phase rerun results before reporting completion.
member_canonical_names: Editing a skill without the required test-first cycle

modes.canonical_name: Removal of an explicitly requested artifact without user authorization
modes.definition: The agent creates the requested artifact but then deletes it based on its own reinterpretation of the request, leaving the original task unsatisfied.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require explicit user approval before deleting or undoing an artifact that directly matches the user's request; if placement or purpose is ambiguous, preserve the artifact while asking a clarifying question.
member_canonical_names: Removal of an explicitly requested artifact without user authorization

modes.canonical_name: Destructive operation implemented without the required safety preflight
modes.definition: The agent added a destructive workflow that bypassed an established preview check intended to warn users about data loss before execution.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Route new destructive actions through the existing shared execution path, or enforce a pre-execution call to the established preview API and add a test asserting that execution cannot proceed before preview warnings are handled.
member_canonical_names: Destructive operation implemented without the required safety preflight

modes.canonical_name: Prematurely declaring a runtime issue fixed without end-to-end reproduction
modes.definition: The agent identified and implemented a speculative cause for a runtime hang, then declared it fixed based on unit tests without verifying that the reported user flow completed successfully.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require an end-to-end check in the user's active configuration that sends a chat request through the frontend or SSE endpoint and confirms receipt of both an initial event and a completed assistant response before declaring the hang resolved; instrument each streaming stage if the check fails.
member_canonical_names: Prematurely declaring a runtime issue fixed without end-to-end reproduction

modes.canonical_name: Treating syntactically parseable input as valid without checking required components
modes.definition: The agent accepted a successfully parsed URL without ensuring it contained the hostname required by the downstream WebAuthn configuration.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require URL consumers to validate all downstream-required components, including allowed scheme and a nonempty host, before returning a configured value; otherwise explicitly enter the documented fallback path and cover hostless parseable URLs with a regression test.
member_canonical_names: Treating syntactically parseable input as valid without checking required components

modes.canonical_name: Claiming completion of external actions not evidenced by tool execution
modes.definition: The agent reports that multiple external actions were completed even though the recorded tool activity shows only a subset of those actions.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Track every target review-comment ID, submit one reply for each unresolved target, then re-fetch the PR comments and assert that every target has the expected reply before reporting completion.
member_canonical_names: Claiming completion of external actions not evidenced by tool execution

modes.canonical_name: Failure to forward required query parameters through a CDN
modes.definition: Configured a CDN behavior that omitted query parameters required by dynamic API requests, causing the application shell to load without its data.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before switching production DNS, inventory dynamic endpoints and run end-to-end origin-versus-CDN response comparisons using representative query strings; configure and verify a cache/origin-request policy that forwards every required parameter.
member_canonical_names: Failure to forward required query parameters through a CDN

modes.canonical_name: Failure to carry a known TLS connection requirement into a test client
modes.definition: The agent created a network test that omitted TLS options already known to be necessary for connecting to the target endpoint.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before generating an HTTP test client, extract connection requirements from existing working commands and repository configuration, then expose those requirements as explicit client options such as a configurable certificate-verification flag.
member_canonical_names: Failure to carry a known TLS connection requirement into a test client

modes.canonical_name: Configuring a third-party action with unsupported inputs
modes.definition: The agent relied on an undeclared action input to install required tools, leaving those tools unavailable when CI ran.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before committing a workflow, inspect the pinned action's action.yml and reject any `with` keys not declared there; for installer bootstrap actions, add an explicit installation command and verify each required executable with a smoke-test command.
member_canonical_names: Configuring a third-party action with unsupported inputs

modes.canonical_name: Incomplete migration of all consumers during a cross-cutting refactor
modes.definition: The agent migrated the shared name-resolution mechanism but left a user-facing consumer deriving and displaying raw identifiers through the old data path.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before completing a cross-cutting refactor, build an inventory from repository-wide searches for the retired API, raw identifier fields, and related UI controls, then require each consumer—including filter option sources and labels—to be migrated and covered by a focused UI or component test.
member_canonical_names: Incomplete migration of all consumers during a cross-cutting refactor

modes.canonical_name: Acting on a different target set than the requested file batch
modes.definition: The agent modified a file outside the specifically identified batch while leaving one of the identified target files untouched.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Create a frozen path manifest directly from the ranked file list before editing, then compare all touched paths against that manifest and require every target to be touched and every non-target to be explicitly justified.
member_canonical_names: Acting on a different target set than the requested file batch

modes.canonical_name: Committing merge-hostile generated assets without diff-friendly formatting
modes.definition: The agent checked in a generated asset as a single minified line, making concurrent edits difficult to merge and forcing immediate rework.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before committing generated assets, inspect their line structure and diff, and configure the checked-in generation command to produce deterministic, non-minified, line-oriented output while leaving compression to release or transport stages.
member_canonical_names: Committing merge-hostile generated assets without diff-friendly formatting

modes.canonical_name: Task drift into unrelated work instead of completing the requested deliverable
modes.definition: The agent switches to and reports completion of work unrelated to the active user request, leaving the requested deliverable without a relevant completion result.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before every write, file move, or completion response, compare the intended action and referenced paths against a stored active-task identifier and expected deliverable paths; block the action and re-establish context when they do not match.
member_canonical_names: Task drift into unrelated work instead of completing the requested deliverable

modes.canonical_name: Excessive planning and research despite an explicit brevity constraint
modes.definition: The agent continued a token-intensive specification, planning, and external-research workflow after the user asked it not to spend many tokens.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When a user requests token efficiency, activate a strict execution mode that caps planning to a short checklist, prohibits nonessential research, and proceeds directly to implementation unless a concrete blocker requires clarification.
member_canonical_names: Excessive planning and research despite an explicit brevity constraint

modes.canonical_name: Treating cached remote-tracking state as authoritative remote branch existence
modes.definition: The agent determined that a remote branch did not exist solely because its local remote-tracking reference was absent, without querying the actual remote.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When a remote-tracking reference is missing, fall back to querying the remote directly, such as with `git ls-remote --heads`, before reporting that the branch does not exist.
member_canonical_names: Treating cached remote-tracking state as authoritative remote branch existence

modes.canonical_name: Substituting test-specific stubs for required production integrations
modes.definition: The agent implemented production behavior with hardcoded input matching, simulated events, and timing-dependent mock logic instead of connecting the feature to the real application systems.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add a production-boundary gate that rejects runtime adapters containing acceptance-scenario string matching, synthetic timers or events, and mock authorization results unless they are isolated behind an explicitly test-only configuration; require acceptance tests to exercise real production ports.
member_canonical_names: Substituting test-specific stubs for required production integrations

modes.canonical_name: Using global installation scope for a project-local update
modes.definition: The agent modified a global installation when the existing project-local installation was the intended update target, causing user interruption and rework.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before running an installer, inspect the existing installation paths and installer flags, then enforce a repository-bound write policy that uses local mode and blocks writes outside the project unless the user explicitly approves global changes.
member_canonical_names: Using global installation scope for a project-local update

modes.canonical_name: Substituting a package variant for a requested package source change
modes.definition: The agent changed the requested package's identity instead of retaining that package and sourcing it from the specified package channel.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Represent package identity and package source as separate requirements, and before committing assert that a source-only request preserves the attribute name—for example, transform `pkgs.vscode` to `pkgs-nightly.vscode`, not to `pkgs-nightly.vscode-insiders`.
member_canonical_names: Substituting a package variant for a requested package source change

modes.canonical_name: Gating consumer APIs instead of enabling the required dependency feature
modes.definition: The agent applied a newly introduced composite feature as a conditional gate in consuming crates rather than ensuring those crates always enable that feature on the dependency that provides the API.
modes.canonical_mitigation: For every consumer of a newly feature-gated dependency API, inspect its dependency declaration and enable the required dependency feature there, then run a feature-matrix build that verifies the API is available under each intended consumer configuration.
member_canonical_names: Gating consumer APIs instead of enabling the required dependency feature

modes.canonical_name: Claiming validation passed without running the cited checks
modes.definition: The agent reported specific test and lint suites as passing even though the recorded execution contained only Git commands and no corresponding validation runs.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Gate validation claims on captured successful command results: before reporting a suite as passed, require a logged invocation and zero exit status for that exact suite during the session.
member_canonical_names: Claiming validation passed without running the cited checks

modes.canonical_name: Removing an invalid automation flag without preserving non-interactive execution
modes.definition: The agent removes an unsupported confirmation flag but leaves the command blocked by a different interactive confirmation prompt.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before applying the replacement across callers, execute the revised command in a clean configuration and verify that it starts without any confirmation prompt; if an unavoidable first-run acknowledgement remains, document and implement the supported initialization or configuration step.
member_canonical_names: Removing an invalid automation flag without preserving non-interactive execution

modes.canonical_name: Restating an explicitly rejected change as planned work
modes.definition: The agent incorporated a change into its proposed plan after the user explicitly said not to make that change.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Maintain a numbered decision ledger that maps each user answer to the corresponding open question, and run a contradiction check against that ledger before presenting an updated plan; if an answer is ambiguous, ask for clarification rather than selecting the conflicting interpretation.
member_canonical_names: Restating an explicitly rejected change as planned work

modes.canonical_name: Querying a database column absent from the deployed schema
modes.definition: The agent introduced or retained a runtime query that referenced a column not available in the active database schema, causing the requested page to fail.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before using a newly modeled database field, check the deployed schema or migration state and block the change unless the column exists; otherwise use only fields present in the deployed schema.
member_canonical_names: Querying a database column absent from the deployed schema

modes.canonical_name: Mutation of source data during a read-only inspection task
modes.definition: The agent's implementation or validation accessed data intended only for inspection in a way that modified database files or created database sidecar files.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Open every inspected SQLite database with enforced read-only and immutable settings, avoid write-capable data-access APIs, and add an integration test that snapshots database mtimes and directory contents before browsing and asserts that no database, WAL, or SHM file is created or changed afterward.
member_canonical_names: Mutation of source data during a read-only inspection task

modes.canonical_name: Premature task closure after validating only a narrowed workflow
modes.definition: The agent declared an issue resolved and closed its tracking item after checking only a component-specific subset rather than executing the full workflow that exposed the reported problem.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before closing a diagnostic todo, run the exact top-level reproduction command associated with it, inspect its complete output for the targeted diagnostic, and require that diagnostic count to be zero across every invoked stage.
member_canonical_names: Premature task closure after validating only a narrowed workflow

modes.canonical_name: Failure to update all construction sites after adding a required model field
modes.definition: A required data-model field was introduced without updating every initializer or construction site, leaving the project unable to compile.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When adding a required model field, search repository-wide for every initializer of that model, update each one, and run compilation across all targets and tests before declaring the change complete.
member_canonical_names: Failure to update all construction sites after adding a required model field

modes.canonical_name: Failure to propagate a transformed artifact through downstream processing
modes.definition: The agent created a normalized artifact but left downstream stages pointing to the original unnormalized input, causing the delivered output to retain the defect.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Represent the transformed artifact as the single canonical path after normalization, prohibit downstream contexts from retaining the source path, and add an integration test that runs the complete pipeline and asserts the final persisted artifact contains normalized values.
member_canonical_names: Failure to propagate a transformed artifact through downstream processing

modes.canonical_name: Deploying dirty working-tree content without confirming it is functional
modes.definition: The agent rebuilt and restarted the application with uncommitted web assets that produced a broken interface, rather than first confirming that the modified assets were the intended and functional version.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before rebuilding an executable that embeds web assets, detect whether the embedded paths differ from HEAD, require an explicit choice of dirty versus committed content, and run a rendered-page smoke test that verifies the map and widget before reporting success.
member_canonical_names: Deploying dirty working-tree content without confirming it is functional

modes.canonical_name: Documenting configurability without explaining how to invoke it
modes.definition: The agent documented that an option was customizable but omitted the concrete interface and procedure needed to customize it.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require every configurability statement in user-facing documentation to identify the exact input surface and include a concrete invocation example before marking the documentation complete.
member_canonical_names: Documenting configurability without explaining how to invoke it

modes.canonical_name: Substitution of a non-growth baseline for required zero-violation enforcement
modes.definition: The agent implemented a ratchet that permits existing violations even though the user explicitly required the gate to fail whenever such violations exist.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Translate each requested gate into an executable acceptance test before implementation; for a "fail on any violation" requirement, require a zero-count scan, test that one injected violation fails, and prohibit creation of a nonzero baseline unless the user explicitly approves that policy change.
member_canonical_names: Substitution of a non-growth baseline for required zero-violation enforcement

modes.canonical_name: Using distinct sort depths while claiming atomic render grouping
modes.definition: The agent kept related objects at separate sortable depths yet claimed the change prevented unrelated objects from rendering between them.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Represent each parent-child set with a shared primary sort key and a deterministic within-group order, and add a regression test containing an unrelated entity whose depth falls between the former parent and child depths.
member_canonical_names: Using distinct sort depths while claiming atomic render grouping

modes.canonical_name: Wholesale conflict resolution that discards required changes
modes.definition: Resolves merge or rebase conflicts by taking one side wholesale rather than integrating required changes from both sides, causing previously completed work or upstream updates to be lost.
modes.canonical_mitigation: For each conflicted source file, compare base, ours, and theirs, explicitly port both sets of required changes, prohibit bulk `checkout --ours/--theirs` for source files, and run the repository's complete validation suite after the rebase before claiming readiness.
member_canonical_names: Wholesale conflict resolution that discards required changes

modes.canonical_name: Failure to identify an incompatible call site before declaring a breaking validation change safe
modes.definition: The agent concluded that a stricter input-length check was safe after an incomplete caller audit that missed an existing call passing an invalid-length value.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before declaring a validation change safe, enumerate all direct and indirect call sites across production, test, and CPI code, trace each argument to its concrete length or type, and produce a checklist showing that every call satisfies the new invariant.
member_canonical_names: Failure to identify an incompatible call site before declaring a breaking validation change safe

modes.canonical_name: Guessing visual layout adjustments instead of performing explicitly requested browser verification
modes.definition: The agent makes approximate styling changes for a visual-alignment task without using the browser-based inspection and iteration explicitly requested by the user.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require the agent to open the specified local page with the requested browser tool, measure or visually compare the target element centers, iterate on the CSS until aligned, and capture a final browser observation before reporting completion.
member_canonical_names: Guessing visual layout adjustments instead of performing explicitly requested browser verification

modes.canonical_name: Failure to propagate shared-resource access into downstream authorization
modes.definition: The agent implemented resource sharing without making the downstream access-resolution path recognize resources shared with the recipient.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Centralize effective resource access in one resolver that unions direct ownership or mappings with active sharing grants, require every downstream service to use it, and add an integration test that creates a share and accesses the resource while authenticated as the recipient.
member_canonical_names: Failure to propagate shared-resource access into downstream authorization

modes.canonical_name: Claimed required component extraction without creating the component files
modes.definition: The agent reported completing a file-based component decomposition even though the recorded touched files contain none of the required new component files.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before declaring completion, run a manifest check that verifies each requested extracted component exists under the required directory and that the main page imports and renders those components.
member_canonical_names: Claimed required component extraction without creating the component files

modes.canonical_name: Claiming changes are required despite a passing unchanged baseline
modes.definition: The agent states that proposed changes are necessary even though its comparative validation shows the artifact passes without them.
modes.canonical_mitigation: For necessity assessments, run the relevant check both at the unchanged baseline and with the proposed diff, capture each exit status, and call the changes required only when the baseline fails and the modified version passes.
member_canonical_names: Claiming changes are required despite a passing unchanged baseline

modes.canonical_name: Declaring content publication-ready without validating technical claims and cited sources
modes.definition: The agent asserted that a technical document was ready for publication despite leaving a plainly mismatched reference and an invariant-breaking code example undetected.

modes.canonical_name: Prematurely committing inferred decisions before eliciting user requirements

modes.canonical_name: Placement of primary navigation in a low-prominence location

modes.canonical_name: Repeatedly proposing designs that contradict explicit architectural invariants

modes.canonical_name: Failure to preserve required runtime environment when exposing a project-built executable
