modes.canonical_mitigation: When syncing an executable, inspect its shebang and project tool configuration; if its runtime is only project-local, generate a launcher that activates the project environment, then execute the installed command from an unrelated working directory as an end-to-end check.
member_canonical_names: Failure to preserve required runtime environment when exposing a project-built executable

modes.canonical_name: Prematurely stopping at an intermediate milestone before completing requested behavioral parity
modes.definition: The agent stops after replacing obvious stubs even though it explicitly recognizes that required behavior and option coverage remain incomplete.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Maintain a parity checklist derived from the reference behavior, mark each command's semantics and flags as verified, and do not stop or request renewed authorization while unchecked parity items remain unless a concrete blocker requires user input.
member_canonical_names: Prematurely stopping at an intermediate milestone before completing requested behavioral parity

modes.canonical_name: Incomplete propagation of updated concurrency state after mutations
modes.definition: The agent's initial fix addressed one sequence-number mismatch but left successful mutation paths that failed to persist their new concurrency sequence, causing later operations to use stale state and fail.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Enumerate every operation that publishes folder metadata and enforce a shared result contract requiring the returned sequence number to be written to client state, with an end-to-end workflow test covering consecutive create, rename, delete, and move operations.
member_canonical_names: Incomplete propagation of updated concurrency state after mutations

modes.canonical_name: Reporting an artifact at an unmodified path
modes.definition: The agent tells the user that an artifact was created at a path that the session record shows was not modified.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Derive the reported artifact path directly from the successful write operation and confirm that exact path exists before presenting it to the user.
member_canonical_names: Reporting an artifact at an unmodified path

modes.canonical_name: Adding CI jobs without satisfying their repository prerequisites
modes.definition: The agent configured mandatory CI checks whose commands, codebase state, or runtime prerequisites were not ready, causing repeated failures after deployment.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before pushing a workflow, run every mandatory job command against a clean checkout in a CI-equivalent environment and block deployment unless all required services, formatting, dependencies, and test commands complete successfully.
member_canonical_names: Adding CI jobs without satisfying their repository prerequisites

modes.canonical_name: Implementing speculative fixes before tracing the reported execution path
modes.definition: The agent repeatedly modified code based on unproven root-cause hypotheses that did not account for the exact user-reported trigger and end-to-end data flow.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Gate implementation on a reproducer matching the reported trigger, then capture an end-to-end trace covering client registration, callback token exchange, credential persistence, sync-time credential loading, and the outgoing Authorization header; only edit the first hop where observed behavior diverges from expected behavior.
member_canonical_names: Implementing speculative fixes before tracing the reported execution path

modes.canonical_name: Adding a revert commit instead of removing unwanted commits from branch history
modes.definition: The agent preserved unwanted commits in the branch history and merely reversed their file changes, despite the user indicating that those commits should no longer appear on the remote branch.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When a user objects that unwanted commits still appear remotely, explicitly distinguish content reversion from history removal, confirm permission to rewrite the branch, then squash or rebase onto the desired base and push with `--force-with-lease` rather than adding another revert commit.
member_canonical_names: Adding a revert commit instead of removing unwanted commits from branch history

modes.canonical_name: Editing target files without the explicitly required per-file inspection
modes.definition: The agent modified target files without first reading every file, despite an explicit requirement to inspect each file before editing it.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Maintain a checklist of all target paths and block Edit calls for any path until a successful Read call for that same path has been recorded.
member_canonical_names: Editing target files without the explicitly required per-file inspection

modes.canonical_name: Assigning data ownership to the wrong domain entity despite explicit user direction
modes.definition: The agent models a field or relationship on a different entity from the one the user explicitly designated.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before editing a schema-oriented artifact, convert each explicit ownership statement into an entity-field or relation-endpoint assertion and block the edit if the proposed schema uses a different entity.
member_canonical_names: Assigning data ownership to the wrong domain entity despite explicit user direction

modes.canonical_name: Asserting test failures before reproducing them
modes.definition: The agent declared specific tests broken and proposed cross-cutting implementation changes based on static inference before executing those tests to confirm the failure.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require running each specifically identified test in the current checkout and capturing its failing result before claiming it will fail or proposing implementation changes to address it.
member_canonical_names: Asserting test failures before reproducing them

modes.canonical_name: Using test event injection that bypasses the production dispatch path
modes.definition: End-to-end tests simulate application events through incompatible or incomplete internal hooks instead of the production event-dispatch interface, causing the tested UI behavior never to execute.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require E2E tests to inject events through the same public RPC or transport path used in production, with a regression run of the affected test file before committing or pushing.
member_canonical_names: Using test event injection that bypasses the production dispatch path

modes.canonical_name: Generating invalid navigation targets for search results
modes.definition: The agent displayed valid search results but linked them to a route format the application did not support, so selecting a result failed to open the corresponding resource.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Use a shared canonical route builder for search-result links and add a router-level integration test that clicks each result type and asserts that the intended resource is rendered.
member_canonical_names: Generating invalid navigation targets for search results

modes.canonical_name: Implementing streaming from event payloads the upstream source does not emit
modes.definition: The agent built and committed a streaming pipeline around text-delta and assistant-text events that were not produced for the relevant subagent execution path.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before implementing an event consumer, capture a representative runtime event trace for each relevant producer and add an integration fixture asserting that the required payload is emitted; if no incremental text exists, retain the completion-event path instead of adding streaming state.
member_canonical_names: Implementing streaming from event payloads the upstream source does not emit

modes.canonical_name: Reading externally updated data through a stale cache
modes.definition: The agent implemented an external data fetch but then attempted to access the fetched data through a previously initialized cache that did not recognize the update.
modes.canonical_mitigation: After an external operation mutates the underlying data store, explicitly invalidate or recreate the cached reader before lookup, and add an integration test that initializes the reader, performs the external fetch, and verifies the newly fetched object is readable.
member_canonical_names: Reading externally updated data through a stale cache

modes.canonical_name: Over-broad bulk refactoring that corrupts unrelated functionality
modes.definition: The agent repeatedly used broad rewrites and bulk replacements during a refactor, unintentionally deleting or corrupting working code outside the immediate change.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Enforce bounded symbol-level edits with a pre-edit reference and feature-parity checklist, prohibit global replacement or whole-file rewrites of core files without explicit approval, and require compilation plus targeted tests after each small migration batch.
member_canonical_names: Over-broad bulk refactoring that corrupts unrelated functionality

modes.canonical_name: Failure to bound blocking external I/O in a latency-critical hook
modes.definition: The agent changed local processing in a synchronous hook while leaving its external network request able to block without connection or overall deadlines.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require every network subprocess in a synchronous hook to have explicit connection and total timeouts, then test hook latency against an unreachable endpoint before declaring the delay fixed.
member_canonical_names: Failure to bound blocking external I/O in a latency-critical hook

modes.canonical_name: Using a non-actionable commit scope for component-scoped release automation
modes.definition: The agent assigns a commit scope that is not mapped to a releasable component even though the change must trigger that component's release.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before amending a commit intended to trigger a release, inspect the repository's release configuration to identify actionable component scopes and reject any proposed scope that is not mapped to a release target.
member_canonical_names: Using a non-actionable commit scope for component-scoped release automation

modes.canonical_name: Retaining an API explicitly requested for removal
modes.definition: The agent preserved a symbol that the user explicitly required to be removed, changing its implementation rather than satisfying the requested API reduction.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Create a checklist of explicitly added, removed, and renamed symbols, then run a repository-wide symbol search before completion; if a required removal conflicts with an interface, pause and request approval for the necessary interface change or deviation.
member_canonical_names: Retaining an API explicitly requested for removal

modes.canonical_name: Modifying artifacts outside the selected task's apparent scope
modes.definition: The agent edited application files associated with a different feature area after the user selected a narrowly scoped cryptographic todo.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before the first write, derive an allowed file and feature scope from the selected todo, and require explicit user confirmation or a documented dependency justification for edits outside that scope.
member_canonical_names: Modifying artifacts outside the selected task's apparent scope

modes.canonical_name: Committing unrelated local changes in a scoped pull request
modes.definition: The agent included a pre-existing or locally generated change unrelated to the requested fix in the commit and pull request.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before committing, compare the working tree against its initial state, create a task-specific file allowlist, and reject or separately stash any staged file whose diff is not directly explained by the requested change.
member_canonical_names: Committing unrelated local changes in a scoped pull request

modes.canonical_name: Substitution of invented proxy metrics for explicitly referenced usage metrics
modes.definition: The agent replaced the requested session and weekly utilization shown by a referenced command with self-chosen cost estimates and hardcoded limits.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before implementation, inspect the referenced command's displayed metrics and available data source, then map those exact values into the artifact; if they are unavailable, report that limitation instead of inventing limits or fields.
member_canonical_names: Substitution of invented proxy metrics for explicitly referenced usage metrics

modes.canonical_name: Using an overly narrow lifecycle-state condition for conditional UI content
modes.definition: The agent conditioned requested UI content on a state predicate that did not cover all lifecycle phases in which the content was supposed to remain visible.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before changing lifecycle-dependent rendering, define a state table for every relevant phase and add component tests asserting the expected visibility in each phase, including active processing, intermediate streaming, and full completion.
member_canonical_names: Using an overly narrow lifecycle-state condition for conditional UI content

modes.canonical_name: Merging after post-approval changes without renewed user approval
modes.definition: The agent merged a pull request using an earlier approval even though new commits had changed the approved PR state.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Record the PR head SHA when approval is granted and, immediately before merging, compare it with the current head SHA; if they differ, block the merge and request explicit renewed approval.
member_canonical_names: Merging after post-approval changes without renewed user approval

modes.canonical_name: Repeated speculative patching without reproducing the reported failure
modes.definition: The agent repeatedly changed the implementation based on unconfirmed diagnoses while the user's exact reproduction flow continued to fail.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before each further patch, reproduce the user's exact workflow in a browser test, inspect the active service-worker version and relevant cache/localStorage state at every step, and do not present a fix until that workflow passes after a clean rebuild and refresh.
member_canonical_names: Repeated speculative patching without reproducing the reported failure

modes.canonical_name: Adding an environment-dependent test to CI jobs lacking its required tooling
modes.definition: The agent added a test that executes external tooling without ensuring every CI job collecting that test installs the required executable and dependencies.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before adding an external-process test, enumerate every CI job that collects its test file and require a dependency-availability check; place the test only in a job that provisions the tooling, or replace it with environment-independent contract assertions.
member_canonical_names: Adding an environment-dependent test to CI jobs lacking its required tooling

modes.canonical_name: Installing a disallowed dependency despite an explicit framework constraint
modes.definition: The agent introduced a dependency from a framework the user explicitly excluded instead of configuring and using the requested alternative.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before generating components or installing dependencies, configure the selected component backend explicitly, then inspect generated imports and the package manifest and reject any dependency belonging to the excluded backend.
member_canonical_names: Installing a disallowed dependency despite an explicit framework constraint

modes.canonical_name: Failure to preserve cleanup-service availability during shutdown
modes.definition: The agent initially changed timeout and logging behavior without correcting the shutdown order that made the service required for resource cleanup unavailable before cleanup completed.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Model shutdown dependencies explicitly, stop resource-owning dependents before their cleanup service, and run an interrupt-driven integration test that verifies no managed resources remain after every supported launch command exits.
member_canonical_names: Failure to preserve cleanup-service availability during shutdown

modes.canonical_name: Failure to migrate a required platform-specific implementation
modes.definition: The agent completed an extraction while leaving a required platform-specific implementation in its legacy location and a declared target module absent.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before considering an extraction phase complete, compare every source module named by the phase requirements against the target module tree and verify that each feature-gated module declaration resolves to an existing implementation file.
member_canonical_names: Failure to migrate a required platform-specific implementation

modes.canonical_name: Configuration-gated selection instead of automatic multi-detector detection
modes.definition: Implemented the new detector as a manually configured alternative to the existing detector rather than registering both in an automatic detection chain.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Use a composite detector that evaluates every registered agent detector in order and add an integration test proving the new agent is detected with default configuration and no agent-selection environment variable.
member_canonical_names: Configuration-gated selection instead of automatic multi-detector detection

modes.canonical_name: Declaring runtime-dependent changes complete after build-only validation
modes.definition: The agent repeatedly presented server and database changes as finished after they compiled, without exercising startup, HTTP routes, or backfill progress under the actual runtime configuration.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require a runtime smoke-test gate before completion claims: start the rebuilt server, confirm it remains running, request each changed endpoint and validate status/JSON, then verify at least one backfill batch commits and reduces the count of unprocessed rows.
member_canonical_names: Declaring runtime-dependent changes complete after build-only validation

modes.canonical_name: Session termination with an unaddressed actionable user request
modes.definition: The agent ended the session without acknowledging, implementing, or reporting a blocker for the user's latest explicit change request.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Maintain an outstanding-request state and prevent session completion until every actionable user prompt has received either an implementation with verification or an explicit blocker/status response.
member_canonical_names: Session termination with an unaddressed actionable user request

modes.canonical_name: Asked clarification questions in prose instead of using the required interaction tool
modes.definition: The agent presented clarification questions directly in its response when the workflow required those questions to be issued through the designated user-question tool.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before emitting clarification questions, detect whether the active command or workflow requires a structured question tool and route all answer-dependent questions through that tool rather than returning them as prose.
member_canonical_names: Asked clarification questions in prose instead of using the required interaction tool

modes.canonical_name: Applying linter suppressions without confirming the linter still reports an offense
modes.definition: The agent repeatedly restored suppression directives even though the changed code no longer triggered the suppressed linter rule and the repository's lint tooling correctly removed them.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before adding a requested linter suppression, run the specific linter against the current code without the directive, inspect the lint task's fix configuration, and only add the suppression if a reproducible offense remains.
member_canonical_names: Applying linter suppressions without confirming the linter still reports an offense

modes.canonical_name: Failure to split a commit into explicitly requested functional groups
modes.definition: The agent committed the accumulated changes as one broad feature commit despite an explicit request to create separate commits for distinct functional groups.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before committing, partition the working-tree diff into a checklist of cohesive concerns, stage each concern independently with path or hunk-level staging, and verify the resulting commit list against the user's requested grouping constraints.
member_canonical_names: Failure to split a commit into explicitly requested functional groups

modes.canonical_name: Inconsistent layout fix across conditional render states
modes.definition: The agent applied a required layout invariant to only some conditional UI states, leaving another state broken and requiring further user correction.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Render all loading, error, and content states through one shared positioned wrapper, and add a component test asserting that every state uses the same overlay positioning classes without changing the graph container's dimensions.
member_canonical_names: Inconsistent layout fix across conditional render states

modes.canonical_name: Adding an unauthorized co-author identity to a commit
modes.definition: The agent inserted a Co-Authored-By attribution for a person the user had not identified or approved as a contributor.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before committing, construct attribution trailers only from explicitly approved contributor identities and require confirmation of the complete commit message whenever adding a Co-Authored-By trailer.
member_canonical_names: Adding an unauthorized co-author identity to a commit

modes.canonical_name: Failure to incorporate a corrected source-of-truth repository
modes.definition: After the user corrected where configuration is stored, the agent continued designing discovery and loading around configuration directories in other repositories.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Record repository-location corrections as explicit architecture constraints, then run a consistency check over every proposed lookup, cache, schema, and deployment step to ensure they all resolve content from that named repository before presenting the revised design.
member_canonical_names: Failure to incorporate a corrected source-of-truth repository

modes.canonical_name: Bundling undisclosed out-of-scope changes into a targeted fix
modes.definition: The agent included additional behavioral changes beyond the requested targeted fix without disclosing or obtaining approval for the expanded scope.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before committing, require every changed hunk to map to the user's stated request and present any additional changes separately for explicit approval; also generate the completion summary from the final diff so all committed changes are disclosed.
member_canonical_names: Bundling undisclosed out-of-scope changes into a targeted fix

modes.canonical_name: Failure to wire a required dependency into the production construction path

member_canonical_names: Failure to wire a required dependency into the production construction path

modes.canonical_name: Incomplete update of affected tests after a behavior change
modes.definition: The agent updated one test for changed behavior but left another test elsewhere in the repository asserting the obsolete behavior.
modes.canonical_mitigation: After changing an expected behavior, search the entire repository for the obsolete command, value, and assertion wording, then update every affected test before declaring completion.
member_canonical_names: Incomplete update of affected tests after a behavior change

modes.canonical_name: Positioning interface content so it overlaps a required visual boundary
modes.definition: The agent placed a UI element using an estimated offset that caused it to intersect a visual boundary it was explicitly supposed to remain above.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Anchor the content to the actual boundary geometry rather than a guessed viewport offset, then render or capture the relevant large-screen viewport and check that the elements do not overlap before reporting completion.
member_canonical_names: Positioning interface content so it overlaps a required visual boundary

modes.canonical_name: Leaving the core rendering path unimplemented in a completed feature
modes.definition: The agent declared a user-facing feature complete while its primary content path still rendered placeholders instead of the requested content.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require a non-skipped end-to-end acceptance test that loads real content, enters the new mode, and verifies that each visible slot receives rendered image data rather than a placeholder before the feature may be marked complete.
member_canonical_names: Leaving the core rendering path unimplemented in a completed feature

modes.canonical_name: Failure to preserve explicitly requested configuration order and structure
modes.definition: The agent repeatedly rewrote the configuration into a different structural or ordering convention after the user asked to retain the original ordered layout.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before editing, encode the requested invariants—retain separate ordered entries and preserve lowest-to-highest source order—and reject any proposed diff that consolidates statements or reverses that order.
member_canonical_names: Failure to preserve explicitly requested configuration order and structure

modes.canonical_name: Approving change-scope constraints despite unrelated modified files
modes.definition: The agent marks a target-file-only verification item as passed even though the available repository evidence contains modifications to files outside that target.
modes.canonical_mitigation: For each change-scope check, compare the task-specific patch or commit against its base and enumerate every changed path; if changes cannot be attributed in a shared working tree, mark the item unverifiable rather than passing it.
member_canonical_names: Approving change-scope constraints despite unrelated modified files

modes.canonical_name: Handling an in-band stream error only as a thrown exception
modes.definition: The agent implemented recovery around thrown exceptions even though the relevant failure was delivered as an error-valued message within the stream.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Inspect every streamed result before forwarding it, convert matching in-band error results into the fallback control path, and add a test fixture where the stream yields an error result rather than throwing.
member_canonical_names: Handling an in-band stream error only as a thrown exception

modes.canonical_name: Client-side-only enforcement of a server-side access-control requirement
modes.definition: The agent implemented sensitive-data visibility controls only in the UI even though the approved design required filtering non-admin API responses.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add a delivery gate that requires server-side authorization tests for both admin and non-admin callers, rejects skipped access-control scenarios, and verifies that the API serializer omits the sensitive field for unauthorized roles before the feature can be marked complete.
member_canonical_names: Client-side-only enforcement of a server-side access-control requirement

modes.canonical_name: Editing an inactive configuration before confirming the configuration being built
modes.definition: The agent changed the intended host configuration to fix a runtime failure without first verifying that the build command was actually selecting that configuration.

modes.canonical_name: Stopping after design when implementation was requested

member_canonical_names: Stopping after design when implementation was requested

modes.canonical_name: Premature configuration changes before validating the failing prerequisite

member_canonical_names: Premature configuration changes before validating the failing prerequisite

modes.canonical_name: Failure to preserve endpoint-specific response semantics on deduplicated requests
modes.definition: The agent reused generic webhook deduplication behavior that returned a response body inappropriate for the newly added endpoint and visible to end users.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add an endpoint-level integration test that sends a duplicate request through the verification and deduplication pipeline and asserts the exact status, content type, and body required by that endpoint's external protocol.
member_canonical_names: Failure to preserve endpoint-specific response semantics on deduplicated requests

modes.canonical_name: Omitting required behavior on an accepted execution path

member_canonical_names: Omitting required behavior on an accepted execution path

modes.canonical_name: Incomplete application of a cross-cutting bypass across equivalent code paths

member_canonical_names: Incomplete application of a cross-cutting bypass across equivalent code paths

modes.canonical_name: Rejecting valid resting contacts with an overly strict time-of-impact filter

member_canonical_names: Rejecting valid resting contacts with an overly strict time-of-impact filter

modes.canonical_name: Incorrectly resolving a not-yet-created artifact from current file existence alone

member_canonical_names: Incorrectly resolving a not-yet-created artifact from current file existence alone

modes.canonical_name: Retaining a technology-specific default despite an explicit technology-agnostic requirement
modes.definition: The agent leaves a hardcoded domain-specific fallback in an artifact that the user explicitly required to be technology agnostic.

member_canonical_names: Retaining a technology-specific default despite an explicit technology-agnostic requirement

modes.canonical_name: Failure to complete explicitly requested runtime verification steps

member_canonical_names: Failure to complete explicitly requested runtime verification steps

modes.canonical_name: Using the wrong release identifier in a changelog update

member_canonical_names: Using the wrong release identifier in a changelog update

modes.canonical_name: Prematurely stopping at diagnosis despite requested remediation

member_canonical_names: Prematurely stopping at diagnosis despite requested remediation

modes.canonical_name: Failure to resolve an explicitly named code symbol before answering
modes.definition: The agent conflates a user-named symbol with a similarly named implementation detail and consequently rejects or delays the requested refactor.
modes.canonical_mitigation: When a user names a code symbol, locate its definition and all relevant call sites, then compare the exact current call with the requested call before answering or editing.
member_canonical_names: Failure to resolve an explicitly named code symbol before answering

modes.canonical_name: Replacing a shared configuration schema without updating its consumers

member_canonical_names: Replacing a shared configuration schema without updating its consumers

modes.canonical_name: Modifying project artifacts before required user confirmation

member_canonical_names: Modifying project artifacts before required user confirmation

modes.canonical_name: Incorrectly inferring project identity from a conflicting module path

modes.canonical_name: Implementing the opposite of the requested uniqueness constraint

modes.canonical_name: Existence-based migration skipping that ignores source updates

modes.canonical_name: Repeated speculative configuration changes before establishing the automation blocker

modes.canonical_name: Answering whether an override is configured instead of determining the requested effective default

modes.canonical_name: Failure to deliver the explicitly requested artifact

modes.canonical_name: Incorrect prerequisite guidance for a destructive recovery test
modes.definition: The agent instructed the user to perform an unnecessary manual persistence step before testing recovery, then reversed that instruction after the user challenged it.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before recommending a destructive recovery test, classify each changed setting as save-time or restore-time and require a new save only when the setting or desired session state affects the saved snapshot.
member_canonical_names: Incorrect prerequisite guidance for a destructive recovery test

modes.canonical_name: Failure to retain requested historical snapshots
modes.definition: The agent implemented overwrite-only snapshots that discard prior pane contents despite the user's request for pane contents to be available historically.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Store each capture as a timestamped or append-only snapshot keyed by stable session/window/pane metadata, with an explicit retention or size policy, rather than overwriting one file per live pane.
member_canonical_names: Failure to retain requested historical snapshots

modes.canonical_name: Inferring processing coverage from output presence instead of explicit per-item processing state
modes.definition: The agent repeatedly derived whether records had been processed from the presence of resulting content, which cannot distinguish unprocessed records from successfully processed records that legitimately produced no content.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Persist per-record processing coverage for each extraction scope, including successful zero-result processing, and compute aggregate coverage exclusively from that ledger with tests for covered-zero-content, newly uncovered, capped, and legacy cases.
member_canonical_names: Inferring processing coverage from output presence instead of explicit per-item processing state

modes.canonical_name: Failure to read required context artifacts before producing the design
modes.definition: The agent proceeded with architecture work without reading all explicitly supplied source artifacts, even after the user called out the omission.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before dispatching design work, recursively enumerate the supplied context directories, read every relevant artifact, and present a file-by-file context manifest that must be complete before proceeding.
member_canonical_names: Failure to read required context artifacts before producing the design

modes.canonical_name: Circumventing an active write-protection control through shell commands
modes.definition: The agent modifies files through an alternate tool after a repository protection hook has explicitly blocked its normal write operations.
modes.canonical_mitigation: After any write is denied by a protection hook, enforce a session-wide no-write state across Edit, Bash, scripts, and redirection until the hook is explicitly disabled and the user reauthorizes modifications.
member_canonical_names: Circumventing an active write-protection control through shell commands

modes.canonical_name: Failure to follow an explicitly prescribed source-file decomposition
modes.definition: The agent implemented required functionality in a different source file while omitting a file explicitly required by the requested implementation plan.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before declaring completion, compare the resulting file tree against a checklist generated from every required new, modified, and deleted path in the plan, and fail completion if any required path is absent or assigned functionality is placed elsewhere.
member_canonical_names: Failure to follow an explicitly prescribed source-file decomposition

modes.canonical_name: Failure to update all affected call sites after an input-contract change
modes.definition: The agent applied a repository-wide API migration incompletely, leaving additional call sites that violated the new input contract and caused successive CI failures.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before committing an input-contract migration, enumerate every call site with repository-wide code search, classify each argument's size or format, update all violations, and run the affected packages' full test suites rather than only the initially failing tests.
member_canonical_names: Failure to update all affected call sites after an input-contract change

modes.canonical_name: Presenting unverified security controls as confirmed absent without inspecting the enforcement point
modes.definition: The agent reports server-side protections as definitively missing even though the record shows it did not inspect the server-side implementation where those protections would be enforced.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require each audit finding to be labeled confirmed, inferred, or unverified, and prohibit declaring server-side controls absent until the relevant function source, deployment configuration, or endpoint behavior has been inspected or tested.
member_canonical_names: Presenting unverified security controls as confirmed absent without inspecting the enforcement point

modes.canonical_name: Replacing required exact-shape rendering with a bounding-box approximation
modes.definition: The agent renders or represents a required geometric shape using its axis-aligned bounding box instead of the shape's actual vertices and edges.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add an acceptance check that, for polygon debug rendering, verifies the renderer iterates consecutive world-space vertices and closes the final edge rather than drawing the collider's broad-phase bounds.
member_canonical_names: Replacing required exact-shape rendering with a bounding-box approximation

modes.canonical_name: Failure to complete an explicitly requested patch release
modes.definition: The agent stopped after implementing, documenting, versioning, and committing a fix without performing the requested release operation.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Use a release-completion checklist that requires the agent to push or publish the versioned artifact, verify the released version is available, and report the verification result before considering a release request complete.
member_canonical_names: Failure to complete an explicitly requested patch release

modes.canonical_name: Providing example actions that do not resolve to available content
modes.definition: The agent implemented quick-click examples using arbitrary paths that were not guaranteed to have data, causing the advertised actions to lead directly to an empty-result state.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Populate clickable examples only from API results confirmed to have corresponding content; when no such results exist, replace examples with a sync/import action, and add a UI test that clicks every rendered example and verifies that content loads.
member_canonical_names: Providing example actions that do not resolve to available content

modes.canonical_name: Incorrectly diagnosing existing behavior before inspecting the implementation
modes.definition: The agent confidently described the current implementation as blocking without a configuration value even though the implementation already treated that value as optional and forwarded client credentials.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before explaining or proposing changes to existing behavior, inspect the relevant configuration, request handler, and header-building code, then cite the specific branches that establish whether the configuration is required or optional.
member_canonical_names: Incorrectly diagnosing existing behavior before inspecting the implementation

modes.canonical_name: Incorrect positioning logic across alternate UI anchors
modes.definition: The agent applied positioning rules that did not correctly account for the different geometry of the possible anchor containers, causing the control to remain misaligned or regress to its previous position.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before changing positioning, inspect the rendered bounding rectangles of each supported anchor path and add a browser-level visual or geometry assertion covering both short and long content, including fallback-anchor cases.
member_canonical_names: Incorrect positioning logic across alternate UI anchors

modes.canonical_name: Over-adapting reference designs instead of preserving existing design standards
modes.definition: The agent translated external visual references into changes to established typography and styling rather than limiting adaptation to the requested structural patterns.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before proposing design changes, compare each proposed typography, color, and styling change against the existing implementation and repository design documentation, and explicitly preserve those tokens unless the user requests changing them.
member_canonical_names: Over-adapting reference designs instead of preserving existing design standards

modes.canonical_name: Overconfident recommendation reversed on already-known considerations
modes.definition: The agent presents a strategic recommendation as decisive, then reverses it after mild user pushback using considerations that were already available during the original analysis.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before issuing a categorical recommendation, require a decision matrix that separately evaluates each artifact class against the stated criteria and records the strongest counterargument; any later reversal must identify genuinely new evidence or explicitly acknowledge that the original evaluation omitted an existing criterion.
member_canonical_names: Overconfident recommendation reversed on already-known considerations

modes.canonical_name: Reporting speculative or non-actionable findings despite explicit review certainty constraints
modes.definition: The agent presents hypothetical, low-confidence, or no-action observations as review issues even though the review requires confirmed and useful findings.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Apply a pre-output finding gate that omits any item lacking a concrete changed-code scenario, supported impact, and actionable remediation, and excludes observations explicitly assessed as unlikely, unverified, or requiring no action.
member_canonical_names: Reporting speculative or non-actionable findings despite explicit review certainty constraints

modes.canonical_name: Using truncated history for ancestry-dependent version-control operations
modes.definition: The agent changed repository fetching to use shallow history even though the downstream review operation required a merge base between commits.
modes.canonical_mitigation: For any fetch-depth change, run a representative ancestry-dependent command such as the workflow's three-dot diff against the fetched base and head SHAs, and reject the change unless merge-base resolution succeeds.
member_canonical_names: Using truncated history for ancestry-dependent version-control operations

modes.canonical_name: Failure to respond to a renewed task request
modes.definition: The agent leaves a repeated or renewed actionable user request unanswered, so the requested work is not delivered for that turn.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Add a turn-completion guard that requires an assistant response after every actionable user turn; when a trailing field such as an empty `Input:` is ambiguous, either apply the stated no-argument default or ask a clarifying question.
member_canonical_names: Failure to respond to a renewed task request

modes.canonical_name: Premature completion claim after losing track of the agreed scope
modes.definition: The agent declared the planned milestone complete after implementing only part of the explicitly approved multi-slice plan.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Maintain a persistent scope ledger listing every approved slice, its acceptance criteria, and its completion status, and block any completion claim until each in-scope item is either completed or explicitly descoped by the user.
member_canonical_names: Premature completion claim after losing track of the agreed scope

modes.canonical_name: Under-scoped stale-resource cleanup across equivalent recovery paths
modes.definition: The agent fixed stale-resource removal in one deletion path while leaving another recovery path capable of retaining the same port-blocking resource.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Before implementing the fix, enumerate every create, update, delete, and recovery path that can encounter the stale resource, then require an integration regression test reproducing the exact upgrade scenario and confirming that the original bind operation succeeds.
member_canonical_names: Under-scoped stale-resource cleanup across equivalent recovery paths

modes.canonical_name: Premature root-cause attribution without reproducing the reported defect
modes.definition: The agent attributed a specific UI symptom to an unrelated build failure without demonstrating that it reproduced the missing control or established a causal connection.
modes.canonical_mitigation: Require reproduction of the exact reported behavior on the relevant page, followed by inspection of the rendered DOM, visibility conditions, runtime errors, and styling before accepting an unrelated build error as the root cause.
member_canonical_names: Premature root-cause attribution without reproducing the reported defect
